params.caption: 🎮 EU's Digital Fairness Act could reshape how games make money The European Commission has published its proposed Digital Fairness Act, a day after a draft of it leaked. The rules could change how video games are monetised, and not only in Europe but worldwide. A new mini-site explains the Act in plainer language. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 20:25 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 💰 Good news for players? React 👍 or 👎 · 💬 Tell us your take below #DigitalFairnessAct #GamingNews #EU
